title: payment-api 503 storm 14 minutes after v2.17.4
summary: First exposure to the Redis connection-pool exhaustion pattern. The agent has no useful organisational memory here, tries a restart, learns it does not hold, then resolves by rolling back and fixing the pool configuration.
symptom: HTTP 503 rate increased from 0.4% to 31% and checkout completion collapsed.
demo_notes: Runbook says 'restart the pods'. That is exactly the trap: the restart is remembered as a failed action for the rest of the demo.
